newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Samara region to issue eurobonds from July.
newsitem.headline: Russian Samara region to issue eurobonds from July.

text.p: Russia's Samara region plans to start Eurobond issues this July and is to issue $250-$400 million worth of paper in several issues with a monthly interval, Deputy Governor Gabibula Khasayev said on Wednesday.
"According to our programme, we shall start the issue in July," Khasayev told Reuters. "The total planned volume is $250-$400 million in several issues with a monthly lag."
Khasayev said the Samara region had already chosen a lead manager but refused to name the bank.
He said the regional administration was working with several financial institutions preparing a rating.

Several Russian cities and regions, including Nizhny Novgorod region, St Petersburg and Leningrad region, are preparing to issue Eurobonds. The City of Moscow is carrying out a road-show for its own paper.
